Tri-Cities Furs just took over Azúcar and the whole city is about to feel it. 🐾 Furanium Fever is landing on Main Floor with vendors, drag, and an EDM DJ ready to melt the room down. This is the kind of night you circle on the calendar and tell your whole crew about — furry, furry-curious, or just plain curious, everybody's invited to get weird on the dance floor. Neon paws, glitter, bass that hits like a heartbeat — Pasco has never seen a night quite like this one. Grab your spot before it fills up, because word's already spreading fast. 🔥

📅 Saturday, September 26 | 6PM–2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15
🔞 21+

Disco ball spinning, glow paint glowing, bass rattling your ribcage — welcome to Furanium Fever. 🌈 Picture it: vendor booths lit up in neon, drag performers commanding the spotlight, and an EDM DJ stacking beat after beat while the crowd moves as one big, sweaty, glittery organism. The energy in Azúcar's Main Floor is going to be electric, thick enough to taste. Every corner has something to catch your eye — costumes, color, chaos in the best way. This isn't a night you watch from the sidelines. Come get lost in the lights and let the music do the rest. ✨

However you show up — fursuit, glitter, streetwear, or something in between — Furanium Fever has room for you. 🐺 Tri-Cities Furs is hosting Azúcar's Main Floor for a night built on community, color, and connection. Vendors slinging goodies, drag lighting up the stage, an EDM DJ keeping the floor moving all night long. Furry, furry-curious, or just here for the vibes — this crowd welcomes it all. Pasco's Latinx-forward dance floor turns into a full-blown celebration of self-expression, and nobody's watching from the sidelines. Bring your people, bring your energy, and come as exactly who you are. 💫
